product.olivetti-m300-25.summary: The entry-level M300 that adopted Micro Channel.
product.olivetti-m300-25.history: Olivetti offered the M300-25 in September 1991 as an entry-level Micro Channel workstation alongside the AT-bus M300 models. The service guide includes a network configuration without magnetic drives.
product.olivetti-m300-25.architecture: Memory expansion required modules of the same capacity. The guide documents two banks, 1 or 4 MB modules and 82C452 video. The catalogue classifies the bus as MCA and the guide also uses the label “AT expansion slots” in its table.
product.olivetti-m300-25.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 1.03.
product.olivetti-m300-25.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m300-25.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
